english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for looking after a person or dependent, including being under someone’s care.

examples.english: I care for the child while my sister is at work.
examples.traditional: 家姐返工嗰陣，我幫佢照顧細路。
examples.jyutping: gaa1 ze1 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 ziu3 gu3 sai3 lou6
